_meta.note: Metaphor: the queue that stops costing anything. The post counts the work an AI layer takes off a marketing team — 80 discrete tasks a month, five hours a week — and its own summary is that the team reviews instead of produces. So the figure is a list: the few rows a person still fills in, one of them amber, above a dozen rows left as empty outlines. Bone field.

featuredImage.alt: A centred column of stacked bars on a bone-coloured field: the top few filled solid, one of them amber, and the dozen below them left as empty hairline outlines.
